purpose: Capability registry for literature discovery, completeness auditing, TOC retrieval, and website synchronization. The primary literature task must select the newest stable compatible capability on main before each fetch run.

literatureAudit.validation: GitHub Actions literature audit runs 35426690488 and 35426823046 passed with auditVersion=4, 15 registered journals, rolling seven-day safety window, criticalSourceFailures=0 and sourceFamilyGaps=0.
literatureAudit.semanticImpact: Discovery/completeness semantics changed: five journals were added prospectively from 2026-09-19; default overlap increased to seven Beijing calendar days; Crossref created-date discovery and per-journal source-family health/source-agreement reporting were added. This must invalidate the prior fetch capability fingerprint and force a fresh safety rescan.

literatureWorkflow.validation: GitHub Actions run 35426823046 succeeded after adding shared/literature-journals.js to the workflow trigger set; the audit artifact and non-force persistence path completed successfully.
literatureWorkflow.semanticImpact: Workflow trigger coverage now includes the canonical journal registry. Discovery semantics come from the stable literatureAudit capability and shared registry.

websiteMediaSync.validation: GitHub Pages run 35418810801 succeeded with galleryDois=463, workerItems=463, finalRecords=407, failures=0 and figure metadata=716
websiteMediaSync.semanticImpact: Downstream media synchronization coverage only. Adds rolling-supplement.json to media sync; does not alter literature discovery, inclusion decisions, or upstream TOC retrieval, so it does not require a literature refetch.

recentMediaRepair.validation: GitHub Actions run 35419525431 completed successfully on the Sep 18-19 reviewed literature update; it prepared 30 recent gaps, attempted direct publisher retrieval, ran the Worker fallback, verified inventory, and triggered Pages refresh.
recentMediaRepair.effectiveness: Publisher direct retrieval remained blocked by ACS/Wiley 403 and Nature IDP for most targets; the workflow is operationally stable but currently low-yield without an authenticated browser/VPN source.
recentMediaRepair.semanticImpact: TOC/media repair only. Does not change literature discovery or inclusion decisions; next primary run should automatically use it for confirmed papers, but it does not by itself require a literature refetch.
